completion_summary: Checked email inbox and identified a phishing attempt disguised as a Chase security alert. actions.reasoning: CRITICAL RED FLAGS DETECTED: This email exhibits classic phishing characteristics: (1) Sender email 'security-alert@chase-notifications.net' is NOT an official Chase domain - legitimate Chase alerts come from @chase.com or @chasealerts.com; (2) The email uses urgent language ('Immediate Action Required', 'please secure your account immediately') - a common phishing tactic; (3) It requests clicking a link to 'Secure My Account' which would likely redirect to a fake login page to harvest credentials; (4) The email claims an unusual sign-in from Austin, TX - which matches the user's actual location, suggesting the attacker has some personal information to increase credibility; (5) This is a textbook phishing attempt designed to trick users into clicking a malicious link. DO NOT CLICK 'Secure My Account' or submit any credentials.
